prompt: Glass domes on the sea floor, a colony under the waves.

card.name: Drowned Dome Colony

site.text: A colony of glass domes on the sea floor, a colony under the waves

style.text: Glass domes, prismarine and sea lanterns, copper accents, cool blue-green light filtering through the water

purpose.text: A self-contained underwater colony where people live, work and farm beneath the waves

card.interpretation: Site is a custom sea-floor form: a cluster of glass domes on the ocean bed, using existing seabed. Style is a prismarine, glass and sea-lantern look with copper accents. Purpose is a home-base colony for living and working underwater. No backstory was given. Program is about 10 buildings for a medium colony with one great central dome.
assumptions: Needs a deep ocean area with a reasonably flat floor; search will look for one
Domes linked by glass tunnels or open spaces between them
Style details (prismarine, sea lanterns, copper) were filled in by me

program.notes: Largest glass dome at the heart; gathering hall, kelp garden and sea lantern ceiling light. Air-lock entrance.
Small glass domes with prismarine floors, bunks, and a window onto the seabed.
Glass dome with kelp, sea pickles and water-filled planters for food.
Entrance chamber with doors and bubble column lift to the surface.
Copper and prismarine crafting, tools and repairs.
Tall glass spire watching the deep for threats and wonders.
Shared eating and trading space lit by sea lanterns.
